description: Accounts for each row of item6-digital-spec.json with the reason its row class is not statistical. Hash-bound to the spec extract by the manifest and, through it, to spec/efuse-otp.md.

rows.reason: Array organization fixes the row and column decode width (32 x 8, 8-bit address). The controller decode is exercised by the functional bench at both the 1x8 fallback and the 32x8 target (sim/controller-fv); no row of it is a distribution.

The 1-100 us program pulse is a registered counter range of the controller, checked at its clamp limits (sim/controller-fv 32x8_clamp_lo / clamp_hi) and bounded at the PDK's characterised corners by static timing (sim/controller-sta). The analog pulse event itself is not simulated (spec section 3).
The interface is a fixed set of synchronous ports; conformance is a pass/fail property of the port list and cycle behavior, checked by the functional bench (sim/controller-fv).

Arm-state gating, inactive program drive in reset and power-up, fixed sense-settle count and address-stable-before-enable are sequencing properties, each pass/fail under the functional bench at the min/nom/max corner set (sim/controller-fv).

Declares the corner set results are recorded at (decision 0005); it is the set of points, not a measured quantity, and the digital timing rows are bounded at those points by static timing and the corner functional runs.
States which verification flows must be clean (DRC, LVS, controller verification); each is a tool pass/fail verdict recorded under signoff/ and layout/, not a measured quantity with a spread.
